dishes.name: Akcaabat kofte
dishes.desc: Garlic-seasoned grilled meatballs from the Akçaabat district, just west of Trabzon. Served with bread, peppers and other sides.

dishes.name: Hamsi tava
dishes.desc: Fresh anchovies coated in cornmeal and fried crisp. Often called Trabzon's most famous dish and one of the most commonly served local plates.

dishes.name: Kuymak
dishes.desc: A molten mix of kolot cheese and cornmeal, eaten hot with cornbread. A staple of Black Sea breakfasts and the most served local dish in Trabzon menus.

dishes.name: Trabzon pide
dishes.desc: Thin dough topped with local cheese, often with a cracked egg and plenty of butter. A staple local bake, found throughout the city.

dishes.name: Black cabbage soup
dishes.desc: Kale soup thickened with cornmeal and borlotti beans and finished with butter. Karalahana is the defining winter vegetable of the Black Sea.
